vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: cruzl-sentinel-core
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides basic onchain strategy recommendations and ecosystem scoring using hardcoded values. Analysis of index.js and SKILL.md reveals no network requests, file system access, or sensitive data handling; the code simply processes text inputs to return predefined strategic advice and wallet analysis placeholders.

llm.summary: The code is small and local, but the skill gives anti-bot onchain behavior guidance and has an unexplained sensitive-credential capability signal.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is onchain strategy and avoiding bot-like patterns; this is disclosed, but the anti-detection style guidance and sensitive-credential capability signal are broader than the simple rule-based code appears to need.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are mostly limited to scoring, strategy, and wallet-address analysis, but they explicitly recommend randomized timing, variable transaction sizes, and non-batched execution to avoid bot-like behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, dependency, or remote installer in the supplied artifacts, but the source is unknown and there is no homepage, which limits provenance.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Metadata signals wallet and sensitive-credential requirements, while the requirements list no primary credential and the code only performs static local scoring; users should not provide secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The supplied code shows no persistence, background execution, network calls, file writes, or autonomous wallet operations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: If you use this skill, treat its scores and strategies as static, unvalidated suggestions. Do not provide private keys, seed phrases, wallet session data, or signing access, and avoid using its recommendations to bypass anti-bot or anti-Sybil controls.
